::: {.page-intro}
We welcome highly motivated trainees and collaborators interested in clinically grounded stroke research, outcomes science, imaging, and NeuroAI.
:::

::: {.join-layout}
::: {.join-main}
## Who may be a good fit

::: {.fit-list}
::: {.fit-item}
**Undergraduate and medical students**  
You can commit consistently and want to grow through data analysis, scientific writing, or both.
:::
::: {.fit-item}
**Residents and fellows**  
You are interested in stroke outcomes, epidemiology, neuroendovascular care, imaging, or recovery.
:::
::: {.fit-item}
**Engineers and data scientists**  
You bring experience in Python, EHR data, NLP, medical imaging, or reproducible analytics.
:::
:::

## What to send

Please include your **CV** and a short note—two or three sentences is enough—describing:

- the questions or methods that interest you;
- what you hope to learn or build;
- the time you can realistically commit.

If relevant, include a brief writing sample, project link, or GitHub profile.
:::
